steps.content: The little manta ray beside L.L. suddenly appears, and swims towards your head, wagging its tail.
Eerie data sound effects explode above your head, and the cute little pet instantly scatters into countless signal data, wrapping around you!
Your vision gradually blurs, tiny pixel particles refract colorful light, overlaying in front of your eyes. In the constantly flowing and changing data, you see flashbacks from your past.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Let me see... what kind of different life would you like?
The seawater slowly rises, submerging your throat. When it reaches your eyes, all your senses vanish, and it feels like you're falling into a slumber in the dark.
Help! Help! Someone fell into the water!
Oh no, the wind and waves are too strong, we need a rescue boat!
The surroundings gradually become clear, and you find yourself on the shore of Elysiland, with Luvia Ray and Eleven looking at you anxiously.

The strong wind stirs the waves, and not far away, a small figure is struggling in the waves. You don't have time to think; you jump into the sea instinctively, swimming towards the figure with all your strength.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Don't be afraid! Stay still! Grab onto me!
You swim to the person who fell into the water, letting her grab onto your arm.
Fortunately, the person listens and stops struggling. You support her and swim to the shore, quickly laying her down on the beach to check for water inhalation or other injuries.
Sob... I was so scared, I thought I was going to die.
I was just playing on the beach, but suddenly a wave swept me into the sea.
My hero, thank you so, so much!
A familiar voice rings. You look at the person who fell into the water... It's the owner of the island! The L.L. who was just confronting you!
But your body seems out of control. You want to run away, yet an invisible force stops you.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: How should I repay you?

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Just say it! You are my hero. I will fulfill any request you make!

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: Yes, Chief, you are a hero. Whatever you want, just tell her!

steps.speaker: Luvia Ray
steps.content: You are amazing, Chief! Everyone is proud of you! In the future, I will definitely make a movie based on you!

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: I will also spread your story on the radio!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: No, I didn't do this to gain anything.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I don't need these.

A flash of light passes by, and everything in front of you stutters like a program error. The figures of Eleven and Luvia Ray gradually disappear, and the sunny beach of Elysiland slowly reverts to its original state.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...Is this your "vision" of everything I want?
Obviously, your question and emotions do not satisfy L.L.even the slightest. She lowers her head, as if thinking about something.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: ...Don't you like this story? Or do you want a more thrilling battle?

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: You need a grander version, right?

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Yes, it must be like this, I have seen your data, the life you experienced before was far more thrilling than this!

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Saving just one person is not enough, saving a few is not enough either, you can save a city! An entire sea! Even an entire planet!

A powerful awe suddenly hits, L.L. stirs up a tidal wave from the seabed, surrounding the entire island. The roar of monsters presses near with the waves, and you can palpably feel her control over the Mania on this island.
And as L.L. waves her hand, the particle-like waves gradually form a ruined city, a pitch-black sea of Mania, and even a precarious planet.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: What about this? Does this interest you? Does this satisfy your desire?

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Come on, every scene, every planet, they all need you! Your ability can help them escape these disasters!
The waves surge over, and you are swept in again, with the familiar darkness looming. Unable to tell the direction, you can only choose by instinct.
You advance towards the faint commotion not far away. Suddenly, the darkness surrounding you disperses, and a strange world appears before you.
Ruins, red moon, and constantly emerging black monsters have almost turned this place into a dead city.
A team of masked squad members walks against the crowd towards you. The leading petite girl takes out a gun and solemnly places it in your hand.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: You finally arrived.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: The task of saving the world is now yours.
Summer's voice is somewhat tired. On closer look, her protective suit is already tattered, and her body is covered in wounds.

steps.speaker: I see, you already have an idea. What kind of plan do you want to make?
steps.content: Go, partner, our power will become your bullets and armor!
One by one, the squad members push you towards the deep sea under the giant red moon.
Step by step, then turning into a jog, and finally, you give it your all, strafing the surrounding monsters and jumping towards the center of the deep sea...
White light flashes, and your voice echoes through the sky!
Soon after, lyrical music starts to play. The once ruined and shattered world vanishes, replaced by green fields and shady trees.
And the people around you applaud.
Everyone smiles, including the blue-haired girl in the crowd, who smiles and shouts with the others towards you.
"Great Hero!" "Thank you for saving us!" "Congratulations" "Savior!" "The monsters are gone!" "Wonderful..." "I'm so happy." "Finally, peace..." "The sun is out!"

steps.speaker: Whispers
steps.content: Become one with me...

steps.speaker: Whispers
steps.content: You and I, we make the world... and the world becomes us.
The darkness in front of you quickly fades. You find yourself in the DisSea illusion, holding a pulsating, warm object in your hand.
Whispers in your ear provoke you, urging you to place the object in your heart.
You know that the object in your hand holds immense power.

steps.speaker: Uni
steps.content: Your eyes are beautiful. I really like them.

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: Chief, Daddy will come back, right?

steps.speaker: Cassia
steps.content: Ah... The flowers in the garden are blooming. How fragrant.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: Why the sad face, look at me, give me a smile!
You feel your hands tightly gripping the object, your fingers deeply embedded into it.

steps.speaker: Whispers
steps.content: Ahhhhh!
The whispers in your ear turn into heart-wrenching screams, enveloping you. The overwhelming force that almost suffocates you vanishes the moment you crush the object!
The buzzing in your ears lasts a long time before fading. The long-unseen sun finally rises slowly, dispersing the thick fog.
The surrounding scenery becomes clear. No one is injured, no one has lost anything. There is no trace of apocalyptic events or battles in this world.
Not even anyone cheering for you.
It's okay, history will remember your greatness.
A familiar voice comes from the sky, but when you look back, there is no one under the sunny sky.
Wherever you go, the perfect savior is there.
Countless worlds and scenarios flash before your eyes. And in each of them, you always play the role of the savior.
Abandoned cities, worlds plunged into Mania, even entire planets are saved by a mere gesture of yours.
Once again, you support an injured person away from the war zone. She keeps thanking you in your ear.
Thank you, thank you! I thought I was really going to die there...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Don't thank me, I'm just...
Yes?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...doing what I should do.
You gaze at the world before you, feeling the ongoing and receding episodes of your history in your peripheral vision, scenes of heroic deeds.
The cheering crowd, the kneeling crowd, the gratitude towards you still rings in your ears, fanatical like the followers of this island chasing joy.
Your mind becomes increasingly chaotic, and you can only bite your tongue, using the pain to stay sober.
You wave off the tightening hand clutching your arm, summoning the shackles with all your might...
A red light flashes, and the illusions created by data disperse before you. You and the blue-haired girl beside you are back on Elysiland.
The Mania mixed with massive data becomes unstable due to your shackles, attacking you along with the twisted creatures from the sea!
